title: Sarah Geronimo 'enjoying her happy life,' says Viva's Vic del Rosario
summary: Popstar Royalty Sarah Geronimo will return to work in 2027 but is "enjoying her happy life" for now, according to Viva patriarch Vic del Rosario.
